correctness.rationale: For a shattered sample an all-positive center reserves a coordinate symbol and induces three equality partitions. Its possible excluded traces are exactly all unions of at most one block per partition, with a constructive converse. Bell-number restricted-growth enumeration is complete. All 6-point partitions reduce to 11 shapes of the first partition and unordered pairs of 203 choices for the remaining two; necessary singleton/private-coordinate and candidate-count filters leave 27,375 configurations, all with at most 61 patterns. Separately 4-point caps (2,2,4), 5-point caps (2,5,5) and (3,3,3) permit 0 shattered cases among 960, 43,264 and 68,921 combinations. Concrete 3/4/5 point samples realize 8/16/32 traces in the actual open-neighborhood model. Standalone standard-library verifier was executed successfully; finite checks do not substitute for the proved reduction.

value.rationale: Provides an exact classification of a natural NIP/neighborhood-complexity invariant for every size triple of nonbinary complete-graph factors, with three sharply different values and two parameter thresholds. The five-point case distinguishes categorical products from the bounded-three Cartesian Hamming case, and the reduction to three partition-union systems yields a small universally exhaustive proof certificate. This is a complete natural three-factor classification, not an arbitrary finite test or a slight numerical improvement.
